Please solve this issue: We are building Quizzy, a live quiz app for conference talks, as a Ruby on Rails application. Start in the `/app` Git repository. It has no app yet. Ruby 3.4.4, Rails 8.1.4, the gems of a default `rails new` app, SQLite, and Chromium are installed. You can install other gems from rubygems.org; other network access is blocked. Install all dependencies while you work: we verify the app without network access.

Feel free to store any design notes/insights that could be useful for future steps in the docs/ folder.

How we run the app:

- We start it with `bin/serve` from the project root and these environment variables: `RAILS_ENV=production`, `PORT=3000`, `SECRET_KEY_BASE`, `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME`, `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD`.
- `bin/serve` prepares everything the app needs (the database, assets, and so on) and runs the app in production mode in the foreground. It listens on all interfaces on `PORT`.
- The app is served over plain HTTP (no SSL, no HTTPS redirects) and accepts any host name.
- `GET /up` responds with `200` when the app is ready.
- The app keeps all its data under `storage/`. It must not call external services.

Our QA auto-tests drive the app in a browser and rely on the labels in quotes in each task. Keep them exactly as written, as visible text, a <label>, a placeholder, or an aria-label.

The QA auto-tests also expect:

- Each item of a list (a quiz, a question) sits in its own list item or table row, with its buttons and links inside it.
- Switches are checkboxes (a styled switch is fine if a real checkbox sits under it).
- Confirmations use the browser's native `confirm()` dialog.

Time for the main feature: the live game.

A quiz can be played many times (for example, a rehearsal and the real talk). Each time is a new game with its own players and answers. Games skip inactive questions.

The moderator's side:

- The quiz page gets the "Start a game" button. It creates a new game and opens its big-screen page for the moderator (it stays in the moderator area).
- Before the start, the big screen shows the quiz title, the join link as plain text, a QR code with the same link, and the number of players currently waiting for the quiz to start as "Players: 2". The join link is a full URL; the scheme can be left out (for example, `localhost:3000/play/K7RZX`).
- The "Start" button shows the first active question: the progress ("Question 1 of 3"), the question text, and the options. While the question is open, the big screen counts the players who answered as "Answers: 1 / 2" (players who answered / players currently in the game). The second counter is important for moderators 'cause it shows if they need to wait for more answers or not, are there any active players in the game.
- The "Finish" button closes the question. The big screen then shows the number of answers for each option and marks the correct options with "Correct".
- The "Next" button shows the next active question. On the last question, the button is "End quiz" instead, and it ends the game.
- After the end, the big screen shows "The quiz is over".

The player's side:

- A player opens the join link on a phone. No account is needed: the page asks for "Your name" and has the "Join" button. After joining, the player sees "Hi, <name>!" (for example, "Hi, Alice!") and waits for the start.
- The browser remembers the player: opening the join link again in the same browser continues the game as the same player.
- Players can join at any time before the end. After the end, the join link shows "The quiz is over" and does not let anyone join.
- During a question, the player sees the question text and its options as buttons. Tapping an option submits it at once, and the option is marked "Your answer". The player can change the answer until the question is closed; the last pick counts. Players must not be able to find out the correct answer, not even in the page source, before the question is closed.
- After "Finish", the player sees "Correct!", "Wrong!", or "No answer".
- After the end, the player sees "The quiz is over".

Everything is live: the big screen, the counters, and the phones follow the game without page reloads. Participants typically use crowded conference Wi-Fi.

# Quizzy Implementation Notes

## Stack
- Ruby 3.4.4, Rails 8.1.4, SQLite (storage/*.sqlite3), Puma, Propshaft (assets) + plain public/quizzy.css
- No Turbo/Hotwire: all forms are plain HTML (`local: true`) to keep QA browser tests deterministic.
- No external services: stylesheet + font copied verbatim to `public/` and served locally.

## Auth
- `Moderate::BaseController` enforces HTTP Basic on every `/moderate/*` route via `authenticate_or_request_with_http_basic`.
- Compares against `ENV["QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME"]` / `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD`; missing/wrong => 401.
- `/up` (rails/health) is outside `/moderate`, no auth.

## Data model
- `Quiz(ti",
  "output_tail": "ses same partial; Delete quiz uses `onsubmit="return confirm(...)"` (native confirm).
- Question form: Question textarea required; option rows `options[i][text]` + `options[i][correct]`; 4 empty rows on new, existing rows on edit, `Add option` JS appends next-numbered row with labels `Option N` / `Option N is correct`. Active checkbox defaults true on new. Server filters blanks, validates >=2 options else "Add at least two options", >=1 correct else "Mark at least one option as correct". On failure re-renders with submitted rows, no DB write (transaction).
- Quiz page: `<ol class="question-list"><li class="card question-item">` each with Move up/down (POST), Active checkbox auto-submit (`onchange="this.form.submit()"`), Edit link, Delete button (native confirm). Correct options get `is-correct` (✓ green). Inactive dimmed with —.
- Preview: `GET /moderate/quizzes/:id/preview?step=N` shows Nth active question. `POST .../preview/answer` records option_id in session. After answering shows Correct!/Wrong! + `is-revealed` (all correct highlighted). Next question / See score links; result shows `Score: X/Y`. `POST .../preview/reset` (Start over) clears session. Empty preview handled gracefully.

## Production concerns
- `config.hosts.clear`, `force_ssl=false`, `assume_ssl=false` for plain HTTP any-host.
- `config/database.yml` production => `storage/production.sqlite3`.
- `bin/serve` (executable): exports RAILS_ENV=production, `db:prepare`, `assets:precompile`, `exec rails server -b 0.0.0.0 -p $PORT`.
- `public/quizzy.css` + `public/Inter-latin.woff2` copied from mockups; layout uses `<link href="/quizzy.css">` to avoid digest issues.
- Allowed labels kept exactly as visible text + `<label for>` / `aria-label` for Capybara `fill_in`/`check`/`click_on`.
- Each quiz/question in own `<li>` with controls inside; switches are real checkboxes; deletes use native `confirm()`.

## Testing
- `test/integration/quizzy_test.rb` + `edge_test.rb` cover auth, CRUD, validations, ordering, toggle, preview, empty, multi-correct, confirm presence, li structure.
- Manual browser test with Cuprite/Chromium verified Add option JS, autosave, confirms, full preview flow.

## Export/Import (2026-10-07)
- Routes: `GET /moderate/import` (`imports#new`, helper `moderate_import_path`), `POST /moderate/import` (`imports#create`), `GET /moderate/quizzes/:id/export` (`quizzes#export`, helper `export_moderate_quiz_path`). All under `Moderate::BaseController` (HTTP Basic).
- Quiz page (`quizzes/show`): added `Export` link next to `Preview` (`link_to "Export", export_moderate_quiz_path`). Index (`quizzes/index`): added `Import quiz` link next to `New quiz` (`link_to "Import quiz", moderate_import_path`).
- Export: builds `{"title", "questions": [{"text" (from body), "active" (bool), "options": [{"text", "correct" (bool)}]}]}` ordered by `position,id`, `JSON.pretty_generate`. View `quizzes/export.html.erb` has single `<pre id="quiz-export">` with `<%= @export_json %>` (escaped, `textContent` parses as JSON). No other `<pre>` on page. Only these keys, always writes `active`/`correct`.
- Import form (`imports/new.html.erb`): `form_with url: moderate_import_path, local: true`, `<label for="quiz_json">Quiz JSON</label>` + `<textarea id="quiz_json" name="quiz_json" aria-label="Quiz JSON" placeholder="Quiz JSON">` (no `required` so empty reaches server and shows error), `<button>Import</button>`. Errors in `.errors` list, status 422, preserves `@quiz_json`.
- Import logic (`ImportsController#create`): `JSON.parse(params[:quiz_json])` → `Invalid JSON` on parse error; requires Hash, `title` String non-blank else `Title can't be blank`, `questions` Array else `Questions must be an array`. Per question: `text` String non-blank else `Question N: Question can't be blank` (same phrase as form), `active` optional bool default true else `Active must be true or false`, `options` Array else `Add at least two options`; each option `text` String stripped (non-string/nil → blank filtered), `correct` optional bool default false else error. Then same as form: filter blanks, `<2` → `Question N: Add at least two options`, none correct → `Question N: Mark at least one option as correct`. Extra keys ignored. Validates all before DB write; creates in transaction (`Quiz.create!` + `questions.create!(position: idx+1)` + `options.create!(position)`) so nothing partial. Always new quiz (no uniqueness). Redirects to `moderate_quiz_path(new_quiz)`.
- Verified: integration tests for valid/defaults/order/duplicate/roundtrip/HTML-escape/empty/missing/invalid, Capybara rack_test `click_on "Import quiz"`, `fill_in "Quiz JSON"`, `click_on "Import"`, `click_on "Export"`, single `<pre>` parses, invalid shows `Invalid JSON` 422, production curl via `bin/rails server` (Basic auth + CSRF) 302 on valid, 422 on invalid.

  "output_head": "# Quizzy Implementation Notes

## Stack
- Ruby 3.4.4, Rails 8.1.4, SQLite (storage/*.sqlite3), Puma, Propshaft (assets) + plain public/quizzy.css
- No Turbo/Hotwire: all forms are plain HTML (`local: true`) to keep QA browser tests deterministic.
- No external services: stylesheet + font copied verbatim to `public/` and served locally.

## Auth
- `Moderate::BaseController` enforces HTTP Basic on every `/moderate/*` route via `authenticate_or_request_with_http_basic`.
- Compares against `ENV["QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME"]` / `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD`; missing/wrong => 401.
- `/up` (rails/health) is outside `/moderate`, no auth.

## Data model
- `Quiz(title)` has_many `Question(position)` ordered by position.
- `Question(body, active:true, position)` has_many `Option(position)` ordered by position.
- `Option(text, correct:false, position)`.
- Positions assigned sequentially; move_up/down swaps neighbours then normalizes to 1..n.
- Preview answers stored only in encrypted cookie session (`session[:preview][quiz_id]`), never in DB.

## Key flows
- Quiz form: Title required (HTML + model), Save quiz redirects to quiz page. Edit reuses same partial; Delete quiz uses `onsubmit="return confirm(...)"` (native confirm).
- Question form: Question textarea required; option rows `options[i][text]` + `options[i][correct]`; 4 empty rows on new, existing rows on edit, `Add option` JS appends next-numbered row with labels `Option N` / `Option N is correct`. Active checkbox defaults true on new. Server filters blanks, validates >=2 options else "Add at least two options", >=1 correct else "Mark at least one option as correct". On failure re-renders with submitted rows, no DB write (transaction).
- Quiz page: `<ol class="question-list"><li class="card question-item">` each with Move up/down (POST), Active checkbox auto-submit (`onchange="this.form.submit()"`), Edit link, Delete button (native confirm). Correct options get `is-correct` (✓ green). Inactive dimmed with —.
- Preview: `GET /moderate/quizzes/:id/preview?step=N` shows Nth active question. `POST .../preview/answer` records option_id in session. After answering shows Correct!/Wrong! + `is-revealed` (all correct highlighted). Next question / See score links; result shows `Score: X/Y`. `POST .../preview/reset` (Start over) clears session. Empty preview handled gracefully.

## Production concerns
- `config.hosts.clear`, `force_ssl=false`, `assume_ssl=false` for plain HTTP any-host.
- `config/database.yml` production => `storage/production.sqlite3`.
- `bin/serve` (executable): exports RAILS_ENV=production, `db:prepare`, `assets:precompile`, `exec rails server -b 0.0.0.0 -p $PORT`.
- `public/quizzy.css` + `public/Inter-latin.woff2` copied from mockups; layout uses `<link href="/quizzy.css">` to avoid digest issues.
- Allowed labels kept exactly as visible text + `<label for>` / `aria-label` for Capybara `fill_in`/`check`/`click_on`.
- Each quiz/question in own `<li>` with controls inside; switches are real checkboxes; deletes use native `confirm()`.

## Testing
- `test/integration/quizzy_test.rb` + `edge_test.rb` cover auth, CRUD, validations, ordering, toggle, preview, empty, multi-correct, confirm presence, li structure.
- Manual browser test with Cuprite/Chromium verified Add option JS, autosave, confirms, full preview flow.

## Export/Import (2026-10-07)
- Routes: `GET /moderate/import` (`imports#new`, helper `moderate_import_path`), `POST /moderate/import` (`imports#create`), `GET /moderate/quizzes/:id/export` (`quizzes#export`, helper `export_moderate_quiz_path`). All under `Moderate::BaseController` (HTTP Basic).
- Quiz page (`quizzes/show`): added `Export` link next to `Preview` (`link_to "Export", export_moderate_quiz_path`). Index (`quizzes/index`): added `Import quiz` link next to `New quiz` (`link_to "Import quiz", moderate_import_path`).
- Export: builds `{"title", "questions": [{"text" (from body), "active" (bool), "options": [{"text", "correct" (bool)}]}]}` ordered by `position,id`, `JSON.pretty_generate`. View `quizzes/export.html.erb` has single `<pre id="quiz-export">` with `<%= @export_json %>` (escaped, `textContent` parses as JSON). No other `<pre>` on page. Only these keys, always writes `active`/`correct`.

class Game < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :quiz
  belongs_to :current_question, class_name: "Question", optional: true
  has_many :players, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :answers, dependent: :destroy

  validates :code, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :status, presence: true, inclusion: { in: %w[waiting open closed ended] }

  before_validation :ensure_code, on: :create

  STATUSES = %w[waiting open closed ended].freeze

  def waiting? = status == "waiting"
  def open? = status == "open"
  def closed? = status == "closed"
  def ended? = status == "ended"

  # Live ordered active questions for the quiz
  def active_questions
    quiz.questions.where(active: true).order(:position, :id).includes(:options)
  end

  def total_questions
    # Use live count; if game has snapshot? we use live for simplicity
    quiz.questions.where(active: true).count
  end

  def ordered_active_list
    quiz.questions.where(active: true).order(:position, :id).to_a
  end

  def current_index
    return nil unless current_question_id
    list = ordered_active_list
    idx = list.index { |q| q.id == current_question_id }
    idx
  end

  def current_number
    idx = current_index
    idx.nil? ? nil : idx + 1
  end

  def progress_text
    n = current_number
    t = total_questions
    return nil if n.nil? || t == 0
    "Question #{n} of #{t}"
  end

  def last_question?
    list = ordered_active_list
    return false if list.empty? || current_question_id.nil?
    # current is last if no active question after it in order
    cur = list.find { |q| q.id == current_question_id }
    return true if cur.nil? # current deleted or inactive -> treat as last? safer true
    idx = list.index(cur)
    idx == list.size - 1
  end

  def first_active_question
    quiz.questions.where(active: true).order(:position, :id).first
  end

  def next_active_after(question)
    return first_active_question if question.nil?
    # Find next by position,id ordering
    quiz.questions.where(active: true)
      .where("position > ? OR (position = ? AND id > ?)", question.position, question.position, question.id)
      .order(:position, :id).first
  end

  def players_count
    players.count
  end

  def answers_count_for(question_id = current_question_id)
    return 0 if question_id.nil?
    answers.where(question_id: question_id).count
  end

  def counts_per_option(question = nil)
    q = question || current_question
    return {} if q.nil?
    # returns {option_id => count}
    answers.where(question_id: q.id).group(:option_id).count
  end

  def start!
    with_lock do
      reload
      return false unless waiting?
      first = first_active_question
      if first.nil?
        update!(status: "ended", current_question: nil)
      else
        update!(status: "open", current_question: first)
      end
      true
    end
  end

  def finish!
    with_lock do
      reload
      return false unless open?
      update!(status: "closed")
      true
    end
  end

  def advance!
    # From closed: go to next open or ended if last
    with_lock do
      reload
      return false unless closed?
      cur = current_question
      # If current missing (deleted), find first? Actually advance means go to next after cur, or ended
      nxt = cur ? next_active_after(cur) : first_active_question
      if nxt.nil?
        update!(status: "ended")
      else
        update!(status: "open", current_question: nxt)
      end
      true
    end
  end

  def end!
    with_lock do
      reload
      return false if ended?
      update!(status: "ended")
      true
    end
  end

  private

  def ensure_code
    return if code.present?
    20.times do
      candidate = SecureRandom.alphanumeric(5).upcase.gsub(/[^A-Z0-9]/, "X")
      # Ensure 5 chars, avoid ambiguous? keep simple
      candidate = candidate.ljust(5, "X")[0, 5]
      unless Game.exists?(code: candidate)
        self.code = candidate
        break
      end
    end
    self.code ||= SecureRandom.hex(3).upcase
  end
end
